title: What new AI tool blew your mind?
author: JedahVoulThur
selftext:
This week has been nuts with both OpenAI and Google's showcases. And I immediately thought about how to use these new tools that have been announced.

In fact, yesterday and today I've been rewriting a script I wrote a few months ago using Gemini 1.5 Pro. The immense token size makes it the perfect tool for this kind of job. Also, being able to manually set the NSFW and violence filters (to 0 in my case, I hate that shit in other models. Why don't they allow me to create fictional stories using mature themes? I'm an adult and my target audience are also adults. Infinite thanks Google for that option).

Also, I've read that with ChatGPT 4o, we'll be able to show it a picture of a character and it will be able to generate a voice. I loved how human it sounded in the presentation and this use case blew my mind, I'd love to use that so much. Voice generators so far sound too robotic IMHO but this, this will be a game changer. There will be no excuse for not having voice acting in every game if this works as expected.

The only thing I am missing to convert all my dream projects into a reality is an "image to 3D" that works flawlessly. While there are some current tools that are trying to achieve that, they aren't good enough (yet).

Well, have you been following the news? What are the tools you are eagerly waiting for?

comments.author: Impressive-Future481
comments.body:
I wouldn’t say blew my mind, but I share weekly AI tools that are pretty useful and not gimmicks. So I can share some in the chat here, these are just random though. If there’s some particular field u require me to send you some suggestion, let me know :)

For video branding: use vidon.ai, I have been using it for few weeks now. And the tool is pretty decent based on its price. It’s free to try, so you can try to create some animated ads for your brands and if you like it then it can give your brand a boost.

For sales: use Qualifier.ai, I have not used it cause it doesn’t offer a free trial. But based on my research it’s one of the best in its category. So it’s for those who want to get some early sales in their business. It basically automates sales via email (it does everything on its own like collecting data , making emails and sending, scheduling them) so u have to just focus on closing deals.

For meeting: use duet AI with google, not something revolutionary but it’s pretty convenient and hands on if you work remotely and have to attend lots of online meetings. It takes notes and summarizes meetings, and even attends meetings on your behalf.

Ty:)

comments.author: oneoneeleven
comments.body:
I totally missed that (even in the blog) about being able to generate a voice based on a picture of a character. Sounds like a nifty new feature. 

And yes image to 3d is the holy grail for me too and probably a lot of people. Been tracking the developments in this space anxiously. And while they don’t explicitly mention image to 3d (focus is on text to 3d) Yellow3D is looking very promising to me. (Especially after their recent investment from a16z)

comments.author: Inevitable_Force_397
comments.body:
Check out Show Runner, if you haven't already: [https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/business/business-news/fables-streamer-ai-generated-content-showcases-hollywood-fear-around-tech-1235911861/](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/business/business-news/fables-streamer-ai-generated-content-showcases-hollywood-fear-around-tech-1235911861/)

Also Sora is going to be really nice.  
  
Apart from the visual related stuff, I'm looking forward to being able to cheaply generate reliable decisions with AI, with maybe some better parsing tools for models like Llama 3. The day that I can run a three layer deep chain of thought at non-consequential cost, high-speed, and get it to properly decide from a list of choices... well, it will open up a lot of options.

I also look forward to when video generation is good enough that it can be done on the fly accurately and quickly. That will be a nice threshold to pass.
